reader_summary.overview: Olaf Carlson-Wee is the Founder and CEO of Polychain Capital. Olaf is among the crypto OGs, he was the first hire at Coinbase and led risk management before founding Polychain with initial investments from Sequoia, a16z. He was named to both the Forbes 30 Under 30 and Fortune 40 Under 40.

key_points.text: Olaf Carlson-Wee is the Founder and CEO of Polychain Capital.
Olaf is among the crypto OGs.
Our conversation explores Olaf's vision for what is to come in the crypto ecosystem.
